Policies & Guidelines
NOTE:
  • 1
    Login Credentials & Combined Results: You may use any login credentials of your choice, but please ensure you remember your Application ID. To receive combined results, you must log in to Paper 2 using the exact same credentials you used for Paper 1.
  • 2
    Browser Storage & Incognito Mode: This exam portal saves your data locally within your web browser. To prevent the loss of your exam analysis data, please use a standard browser window rather than Incognito or Private Browsing mode.
  • 3
    Data Loss Disclaimer: Currently, our system saves data directly to your device's local storage rather than a centralized server database. Consequently, FocusHub cannot be held responsible for any loss of exam analysis data if you clear your browser's cache or site data.
  • 4
    Platform Access & Unofficial Status: FocusHub currently offers its core exam preparation tools for free to support students in their studies. Please note that this is an unofficial website designed strictly to simulate the real exam interface. Any IIT logos used are solely for educational simulation purposes and do not imply any official affiliation, endorsement, or representation.
  • 5
    Copyright Disclaimer & Takedown Policy: We do not claim ownership of the institutional logos used to replicate the exam environment. If you are an authorized representative of an institution and wish to have your logo removed from our platform, please contact us at focushubquery@gmail.com. We will promptly process your removal request within 48 hours.
